conversion.attribution: First page in the mounted browser document, retained across client navigation; full reload begins a new context. Only fixed source/medium/campaign categories and known public paths are recorded. No cookies, persistent identifiers, arbitrary query values or contact data added. App links carry bounded acquisition parameters; the receiving app/CRM must record successful activations separately.
conversion.dashboard: Vercel Hobby does not expose custom events. Collection remains disabled until a compatible plan and NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_CUSTOM_EVENTS=true are configured. Pageview analytics and bounded app attribution links work without that flag. No plan upgrade or analytics vendor was activated by this release.
